test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 5 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7(1)/(2) hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
solution:
**Given:**

An electric pump can fill a tank in 5 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7(1)/(2) hours to fill the tank.

**Formula used:**

The capacity of tank = efficiency of pipe x Time taken

total capacity of tank = LCM of time taken.

**Calculation:**

Total capacity of tank = LCM of 5 and 7.5

= 15 litre

The capacity of tank = efficiency of pipe x Time taken

The efficiency of pipe = Capacity of tank / Time taken 

= 15/5 

= 3 l/hr

The efficiency of leak = Capacity of tank / Time taken 

= 15/7.5

= 2 l/hr

The volume of water filled in 1 hour = volume of water filled by pipe - volume of water emptied by leak

= 3 - 2

= 1 l/hr

the time required to empty the tank by leak = 15 x 1 = 15hr

**Hence, the correct answer is '15 hours'.**
